messages:
Marta S: Hey finance — corp card was declined at a Paris metro ticket kiosk this morning, had to use personal card. Ticket machine printed a tiny receipt in FR, no VAT number, total EUR 12.40. Can I expense and how do we handle VAT?
Finance Team: Sorry about the decline. Please upload the receipt to Expensify or attach here. For French public transit, most tickets are not VAT invoices; we usually treat them as non-reclaimable VAT but still reimbursable to the employee.
Marta S: Uploading screenshot + photo: https://imgur.com/a/yyy (mock). It shows "TICKET T+" and time 08:17, station Gare du Nord. It's literally a thermal stub.
Liam W: tagging manager @Marta S — per policy, anything >EUR10 needs manager approval for personal-pay incidents. Marta, can you confirm this was business travel?
Marta S: Yes, client meeting at 09:30 in 10th arrondissement.
Liam W: Approved for reimbursement. :white_check_mark:
TravelBot: Note: card decline logged for Marta S on 2025-04-04 08:20 CET. Auto-ticket: merchant not VAT-registered (public transport).
Finance Team: Thanks. We'll reimburse amount to Marta's next payroll run after you submit to Expensify and tag "transport-personal-card". VAT reclaim: mark as "no VAT" and code to travel-expenses-eu. If you happen to get a station invoice or if vendor provides a group invoice with VAT number, send to accounting@redwood.com and we'll attempt reclaim.
Marta S: One more Q: can I add a short note that the corpcard was declined so team can check card limits?
Finance Team: Yes please add note and attach bank notification screenshot if available. We'll also open a ticket with card provider to investigate soft-decline pattern.
Marta S: Added note and bank decline screenshot. Thanks :thumbsup:
Finance Team: Closing loop: reimbursement scheduled, expense marked reimbursed on 2025-04-10 and flagged as non-reclaimable VAT. Card issue ticket created with Payments Ops (ref: PAY-2025-118).
